title: Explore student-oriented account options
intro: A Dutch studentrekening is an everyday account with student-oriented pricing while you are enrolled. Use these soft CTAs to open official sites, then confirm enrolment rules, fee bands and graduation conversion yourself — this block is not a ranking.

items.reason: Onboarding: English-first digital Dutch account many students use for everyday IBAN life. Best for: international students who want app-speed setup. Watch-outs: confirm whether a named student package or youth tier fits your enrolment proof and physical card costs.

Onboarding: Major Dutch retail bank with widely used student / youth everyday packages. Best for: campus life with salary or part-time pay later. Watch-outs: compare monthly student package fees, enrolment proof rules and English support for your branch region.

Onboarding: Full-service Dutch bank with branch depth when newcomers need help. Best for: students who want a traditional retail stack and clear package pages. Watch-outs: verify student eligibility, age/duration limits and the post-graduation fee on ABN’s site.

Onboarding: Cooperative retail bank with Dutch student / youth products. Best for: residents who prefer mainstream campus banking and local presence. Watch-outs: check regional English UX and live tariff PDFs for student vs regular pricing.

Onboarding: App-first EU account some students use for everyday spend while settling. Best for: digital everyday spend and travel. Watch-outs: confirm whether a true Dutch student package or enrolment discount fits rent/direct-debit needs before treating it as your only IBAN.

Onboarding: Spending and FX companion some students use beside a Dutch everyday IBAN. Best for: travel wallets, multi-currency support from family and weekend trips. Watch-outs: not a substitute for every Dutch payroll, tuition or landlord requirement — verify contracts and student eligibility.

disclosure: Some links may be affiliate or referral links. If you use them, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Ordering reflects page relevance, not pay-to-rank placement. Always confirm student fees, enrolment rules and graduation conversion on the provider’s official pages.
